sections.heading: Apple TV 4K Value Post-Price Hike
paragraphs: Engadget has published an article questioning the value of the Apple TV 4K after a recent price increase, sparking debates among tech enthusiasts.

sections.heading: Anticipating the New Apple TV Model
paragraphs: Geeky Gadgets has reported leaked details suggesting that a new Apple TV model is expected to be released in September 2026, fueling excitement among consumers.

sections.heading: Apple TV's Market Position
paragraphs: In contrast to claims that Apple TV is losing relevance, Six Colors asserts that Apple TV is far from dead and continues to hold a significant position in the market.

faq.q: What is the current debate about Apple TV?
faq.a: There is a debate on whether the Apple TV 4K is still worth buying after its price increase, as reported by Engadget.

faq.q: Is there a new Apple TV model expected?
faq.a: Yes, according to Geeky Gadgets, leaked details suggest that a new Apple TV model is expected to be released in September 2026.

faq.q: What does Six Colors say about Apple TV's market position?
faq.a: Six Colors refutes claims that Apple TV is 'essentially dead,' stating that Apple TV continues to hold a significant market position.
